## About

I am a graduate student in the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's programme in Imaging, currently studying at Tampere University in Finland, following my first year at Politecnico di Milano in Italy.

With a background in Applied Mathematics and Computer Science, I am interested in machine learning, computer vision, and data-driven approaches to solving real-world problems.

My experience spans data analytics, recommender systems, and medical imaging research. I previously worked at Kaspi.kz, where I contributed to the development and optimization of recommendation systems, and at Fondazione IRCCS Istituto Nazionale dei Tumori di Milano, where I worked on medical imaging and predictive modeling.

I enjoy working at the intersection of mathematics, software engineering, and machine learning, particularly on problems that require both analytical thinking and practical implementation.
